failure_modes.trigger: Runner quota exceeded mid-matrix
failure_modes.mitigation: fail-fast: false + coherence threshold check in aggregator

failure_modes.trigger: Two shards write same artifact name
failure_modes.mitigation: Shard ID appended to all artifact names

failure_modes.trigger: SHA-256 mismatch between init and shard download
failure_modes.mitigation: Abort with explicit error; manual re-trigger required

failure_modes.trigger: Artifact deleted after 1 day; workflow re-triggered after expiry
failure_modes.mitigation: Increase retention_days or redesign for ephemeral state

architectures.name: Polyglot Test Resonator

dynamic_baselines.fixture_count: Dynamic based on fuzz corpus; minimum 3 synthetic fixtures guaranteed

failure_modes.trigger: Rust i64 > 2^53 causes Python float truncation
failure_modes.mitigation: Schema bridge checks overflow_risk flag; failing fixtures isolated

failure_modes.trigger: rust:1.78-slim unavailable
failure_modes.mitigation: Fallback to ubuntu-24.04 with rustup install

failure_modes.trigger: Malformed Rust fixture corrupts .hypothesis/
failure_modes.mitigation: Delete .hypothesis/ if hypothesis.errors.Flaky raised

failure_modes.trigger: Python 3.11 vs 3.12 JSON float parsing differences
failure_modes.mitigation: Matrix strategy captures both; failures are version-specific, not systemic

architectures.projection_tax: ~40 developer-minutes to debug cross-language ontological shear failures

architectures.name: Recursive Autopoietic Security Loop

dynamic_baselines.iteration_cap: RASL_MAX_DEPTH env var; dynamically checked per issue
dynamic_baselines.vulnerability_filter: Only 'error' severity CodeQL findings trigger loop

failure_modes.trigger: CodeQL finds >50 vulnerabilities triggering 50 parallel issues
failure_modes.mitigation: Hard cap of 3 issues per scan cycle

failure_modes.trigger: Claude generates syntactically invalid diff
failure_modes.mitigation: git apply --reject captures partial applies; PR created as draft for human review

failure_modes.trigger: RASL_ITERATION counter corrupted in issue body
failure_modes.mitigation: Regex match with fallback to iter=0; max_depth always checked before execution

failure_modes.trigger: Auto-merged PR introduces security regression
failure_modes.mitigation: all PRs created as draft: true; requires human promotion to ready

failure_modes.trigger: LLM logs API key in output
failure_modes.mitigation: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY passed via env secret; never interpolated in run: blocks

architectures.projection_tax: ~2 developer-hours/week review of RASL-generated PRs in active repositories

architectures.name: Temporal Escrow Smart Contract

dynamic_baselines.lock_duration: Configurable per DEPOSIT operation; bounded by retention policy
dynamic_baselines.hmac_algorithm: SHA-256; upgrade to SHA-3 for higher security requirements

failure_modes.trigger: 30-day retention expires before unlock condition met
failure_modes.mitigation: Heartbeat job re-uploads artifact to reset retention; monitor expiry in heartbeat

failure_modes.trigger: External oracle URL returns 5xx or times out
failure_modes.mitigation: Oracle unreachable = escrow remains locked; explicit error logged

failure_modes.trigger: TESC_SIGNING_KEY rotated while escrow is active
failure_modes.mitigation: Do not rotate key during active escrow windows; document in ops runbook

failure_modes.trigger: Unlock token intercepted and replayed
failure_modes.mitigation: Include timestamp in HMAC computation for time-bounded tokens in production deployments

failure_modes.trigger: Two actors deposit simultaneously, overwriting artifact
failure_modes.mitigation: Artifact names should include UUID; implement one-active-escrow-per-repo policy

architectures.projection_tax: ~30 developer-minutes to debug failed oracle conditions

architectures.name: Metacognitive Drift Sentinel

dynamic_baselines.lint_scope: Path-filtered on push events; full scan on weekly schedule
dynamic_baselines.llm_context_window: 6000 chars intent + 2000 chars topology summary = within 8K effective context

failure_modes.trigger: No ARCHITECTURE.md, ADR, or DESIGN.md found
failure_modes.mitigation: Graceful fallback to README.md; synthetic baseline generated

failure_modes.trigger: Claude returns explanation instead of pure JSON
failure_modes.mitigation: Fallback drift_analysis struct with score=0.5 and grade='C'

failure_modes.trigger: Drift never resolved; new issue filed weekly
failure_modes.mitigation: Check for existing open 'mds-drift-report' label; append comment instead of creating new issue

failure_modes.trigger: MDS analyzes its own workflow YAML as architectural drift
failure_modes.mitigation: Exclude .github/ directory from topology extraction

failure_modes.trigger: LLM misinterprets intentional polyglot architecture as drift
failure_modes.mitigation: Include polyglot intent declaration in ARCHITECTURE.md; lower threshold for multi-language repos

architectures.projection_tax: ~1 developer-hour/month to triage and resolve MDS-filed issues

reflexive_check_summary.bit_rot_risk: HIGH for PTR (cargo-fuzz API stability) and RASL (CodeQL action v3 schema changes)
reflexive_check_summary.star_count_trap: Avoided: No action selected based on star count; selected on geometric operation class
falsification_conditions: If GitHub runner artifact isolation prevents cross-job artifact reads within the same run: DASM is falsified
If GitHub deprecates actions/upload-artifact@v4 artifact naming scheme: All 5 architectures require update
If LLM API rate limits prevent synchronous patch generation in RASL: RASL must be redesigned as async queue
reflexive_check_summary.mcp_extension_surface: Each architecture maps to an MCP tool boundary: DASM→file_manager, RASL→code_runner+issue_tracker, TESC→secure_vault, MDS→codebase_reader. Local IDE MCP servers can consume artifact outputs directly.

pluriversal_extensions.gitlab_ci: DASM maps to GitLab's DAG pipeline with artifacts:reports; TESC maps to GitLab Environments with deployment gates
pluriversal_extensions.bitbucket_pipelines: PTR maps to Bitbucket Pipe container actions; RASL requires Bitbucket Code Insights API for issue filing
